notes.title: Free Game Tuesday - get 100% off on Nubarron, an adventure of an unlucky gnome
notes.notes:
Here's your quick tip of the day! Until May 9, you can grab a free permanent copy of Nubarron: The adventure of an unlucky gnome on Steam.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/05/free-game-tuesday-get-100-off-on-nubarron-an-adventure-of-an-unlucky-gnome

notes.title: Nubarron is OUT! Check out our behind the scenes stories!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that Nubarron is out!!

We  also wanted to share some behind the scenes stories of the development: https://imgur.com/gallery/e7SX4rD

Thanks for your support!! <3

notes.title: Win 5 Gorgeous Games and Nubarron Early Access
notes.notes:
[h2][url=https://gleam.io/A6W1R/6-gorgeous-indie-games-on-steam-early-access]https://gleam.io/A6W1R/6-gorgeous-indie-games-on-steam-early-access[/url][/h2]

With Nastycloud, we spent about 5 years working on Nubarron, to celebrate the end of that journey we want to giveaway 5 games that inspired us during the development and give one of you early access to Nubarron.

If you want to support independent developers trying to not be a part of the mobile money sucking machine, please consider helping us by joining the giveaway and sharing it with others.

Thanks for your support!!!
